note: Golden flyers for the vision evaluation (B-073). Pictures are built deterministically in code from ground+treatment; answers are recorded fixture fiction keyed by the exact bytes — the honest stand-in for a real vision model until a Meta endpoint exists. The corpus is deliberately imperfect: handwriting omits the cost, rotated omits the place, glare misreads the date by a digit.
